provenance.use: Placement then filters, per-filter blending and premultiplied mask mixing

desktop.behavior: Filters on Smart Objects append editable stack entries; raster layers retain destructive filter behavior. Layer rows expose stack/individual visibility, editing and blend/opacity, move-up/down/delete. First filter creates white or selection-based mask. Brush, Fill, density, feather, enabled/link settings, mask view and deletion use shared native history. Source cache/embedded bytes remain unchanged. Rasterize bakes the visible filter result.
menus: Layer > Smart Filter > Disable Smart Filters
Layer > Smart Filter > Delete Filter Mask
Layer > Smart Filter > Disable Filter Mask
Layer > Smart Filter > Clear Smart Filters
desktop.limits: 32 filters,8,388,608 pixels in the union of canvas and placed bounds; native mask property and source limits remain. Unsupported mask tool targets explicitly reject. Smart filter rendering currently recomputes the stack rather than keeping a separate persistent result cache.

persistence.old_readers: Explicit version15 download negotiation prevents older clients from silently losing stacks.
persistence.psd_psb: Seven mapped filters, per-filter visibility/blend/opacity, stack visibility, filter masks and bounded FEid source planes. Average descriptor, fractional Motion Blur angles and mask density/feather/inversion/fractional-outside settings explicitly reject layered export; native archives retain them. Mask geometry is rasterized into document coordinates for PSD export.
persistence.qualification: Own generated RGB8/16/32 PSD/PSB round trips only. Independent Photoshop interoperability and pixel equality are not claimed.

photato.state: layers[].smartFilters exposes ordered filter IDs/settings/enabled/blend/opacity, stack enabled, mask presence/settings/document transform. capabilities.smartFilters publishes input and state schemas.
photato.history: Same command/prepared-edit/Undo path as desktop; busy/stale handling and cancellation inherited from the shared service.

adobe.scope: Existing options.actions[].source.content actionJSON now selects an exact unique layer name. Supported filter actions preserve editable stacks on Smart Object input; PSD/PSB output uses filterFX/FEid, raster output renders. Same native engine as desktop and Photato API.
adobe.limitations: Eight local algorithms, seven mapped PSD descriptors, existing partial action language and job limits. Does not claim all91 listed Adobe Smart Filters, hosted identity/model behavior or pixel equivalence.

verification.live: Pending unlock; no live161 UI or independent Photoshop check performed.
